title: Polynomial Sample Count Bound
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb{N}$, every subset $P$ of the $n$ coordinates, and all $k,b\in\mathbb{N}$, set $\ell=k-\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor$ and $T_0=1$, $T_{j+1}=1+2T_j$. Let $\delta$ be the per-node failure parameter obtained by dividing $2^{-(b+1)}$ by $T_k$. The polynomial learner's sample count at failure parameter $\delta$ is at most $2^\ell\bigl(\ell+1+\lceil\log_2 T_k\rceil+2(\lfloor3k/4\rfloor+1)+5\bigr)(n+1)^\ell(b+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
